import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import seasonal_decompose

def time_series_anomaly_detection():
    # Create time series with trend, seasonality, and anomalies
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 200
    t = np.arange(n)
    
    trend = 0.05 * t
    seasonal = 10 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * t / 30)
    noise = np.random.randn(n) * 2
    
    ts = trend + seasonal + noise
    
    # Inject anomalies
    anomaly_indices = [50, 100, 150, 175]
    anomaly_values = [30, -25, 35, -20]
    for idx, val in zip(anomaly_indices, anomaly_values):
        ts[idx] += val
    
    dates = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=n, freq='D')
    df = pd.DataFrame({'value': ts}, index=dates)
    
    # Method 1: Rolling Z-score
    window = 20
    rolling_mean = df['value'].rolling(window=window, center=True).mean()
    rolling_std = df['value'].rolling(window=window, center=True).std()
    rolling_z = (df['value'] - rolling_mean) / rolling_std
    rolling_anomalies = np.abs(rolling_z) > 3
    
    # Method 2: Seasonal decomposition residuals
    decomposition = seasonal_decompose(df['value'], model='additive', period=30, extrapolate_trend='freq')
    resid = decomposition.resid.dropna()
    resid_threshold = 3 * resid.std()
    decomp_anomalies = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    decomp_anomalies[resid.index[np.abs(resid) > resid_threshold]] = True
    
    # Method 3: Exponential smoothing errors
    ewm_mean = df['value'].ewm(span=10).mean()
    ewm_errors = df['value'] - ewm_mean
    ewm_std = ewm_errors.rolling(window=20).std()
    ewm_z = ewm_errors / ewm_std
    ewm_anomalies = np.abs(ewm_z) > 3
    
    # Results
    print("Time Series Anomaly Detection Results:")
    print(f"  True anomaly indices: {anomaly_indices}")
    
    for name, detected in [
        ('Rolling Z-score', rolling_anomalies),
        ('Decomposition', decomp_anomalies),
        ('Exponential Smoothing', ewm_anomalies)
    ]:
        found = set(df.index[detected].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        true_set = set(df.iloc[anomaly_indices].index.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        tp = len(found & true_set)
        print(f"\n  {name}:")
        print(f"    Detected: {detected.sum()} points")
        print(f"    True positives: {tp}/{len(anomaly_indices)}")

time_series_anomaly_detection()
